column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “infallible” to “proofs.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “He said.”
NKJV has “witnesses to Me,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “My witnesses.”
NKJV has “Peter, James, John,” following the Textus Receptus order; the critical text reads “Peter and John and James.”
NKJV includes “and supplication,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “in prayer.”
NKJV has “the disciples,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the brothers.”
NKJV includes “this” with “Scripture,” following the Textus Receptus.
NKJV puts verses 18–19 in parentheses as an aside; the Greek has no such marking.
Close to the Greek; “position” is rendered “office.”
NKJV has “to take part in,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to take the place of.” NKJV adds “by transgression.”
